description: This file defines data structures and classes related to managing instances and their presence information in a macOS application. It includes 'InstanceInfo' for individual instance details and 'InstancesStore' for fetching, updating, and notifying about instances' presence, status, and health checks.

classes.name: InstancesStore
classes.description: An observable, singleton class responsible for managing the list of active instances, refreshing presence data, handling real-time push events, and performing health checks in a macOS environment.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Begins periodic refresh of presence data and subscribes to push notifications unless in preview mode.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops periodic refresh and push subscription tasks.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Fetches the current presence list from the control channel and updates internal state.

methods.name: localFallbackInstance
methods.description: Creates a fallback InstanceInfo representing the local machine when remote presence data is unavailable.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Handles incoming push notifications and dispatches actions based on event type.

methods.name: decodeAndApplyPresenceData
methods.description: Decodes presence data and applies it.

methods.name: handlePresenceEventPayload
methods.description: Decodes and applies presence event payloads received via push.

methods.name: normalizePresence
methods.description: Converts a list of PresenceEntry objects into a list of InstanceInfo, ensuring unique identifiers.

methods.name: applyPresence
methods.description: Updates internal presence state and notifies of new node connections.

methods.name: notifyOnNodeLogin
methods.description: Sends user notifications when nodes connect.

methods.name: snippet
methods.description: Creates a short string snippet of a data payload for logging.

methods.name: probeHealthIfNeeded
methods.description: Performs a health check and updates instances list with health status.

methods.name: localFallbackInstance
methods.description: Generates a local instance info object with current machine details.
